info.name: Grid Agent Management Agent Operations API

items.docs: Retrieve the authenticated agent's own profile, policy, and current usage. This endpoint is called by the agent software itself using its own credentials (obtained via device code redemption) rather than platform credentials.

params.name: accountIdentifier
params.description: Filter by account identifier (matches either sender or receiver)

params.name: senderAccountIdentifier
params.description: Filter by sender account identifier

params.name: receiverAccountIdentifier
params.description: Filter by receiver account identifier

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by transaction status

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by transaction type

params.name: reference
params.description: Filter by reference

params.name: startDate
params.description: Filter by start date (inclusive) in ISO 8601 format

params.name: endDate
params.description: Filter by end date (inclusive) in ISO 8601 format

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination (returned from previous request)

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Order to sort results in

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of transactions for the authenticated agent's customer. Results are automatically scoped to the agent's associated customer — no customer filter is needed or accepted.

params.name: transactionId
params.description: Unique identifier of the transaction

items.docs: Retrieve a specific transaction belonging to the authenticated agent's customer. Returns 404 if the transaction exists but belongs to a different customer.

Generate a quote for a cross-currency transfer on behalf of the authenticated agent's customer. Accounts referenced in the request must belong to the agent's customer. Requires the CREATE_QUOTES permission in the agent's policy.
If the agent's defaultExecutionMode is APPROVAL_REQUIRED, or the quote amount exceeds the agent's approvalThresholds, the resulting transaction will require explicit approval before funds move.

params.name: quoteId
params.description: ID of the quote to retrieve

items.docs: Retrieve a quote created by the authenticated agent. Returns 404 if the quote exists but was not created by this agent.

params.name: quoteId
params.description: The unique identifier of the quote to execute

items.docs:
Execute a quote created by the authenticated agent. Requires the EXECUTE_QUOTES permission in the agent's policy.
If the agent's policy requires approval for this amount (based on execution mode or approval thresholds), the transaction will be created in a pending state and must be approved by the platform via `POST /agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}/approve`.
Once executed, the quote cannot be cancelled.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by action status

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination (returned from previous request)

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of actions submitted by the authenticated agent. Use this to poll for approval decisions after submitting an action that requires approval.

params.name: actionId
params.description: Unique identifier of the agent action

items.docs: Retrieve a specific action submitted by the authenticated agent. Poll this endpoint after submitting an action that requires approval to check whether it has been approved, rejected, or has failed.

Transfer funds from an external account to an internal account for the authenticated agent's customer. Accounts must belong to the agent's customer. Requires the CREATE_TRANSFERS permission in the agent's policy.
If the agent's policy requires approval for this amount, the transaction will be created in a pending state and must be approved by the platform via `POST /agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}/approve`.
This endpoint should only be used for external account sources with pull functionalit

Transfer funds from an internal account to an external account for the authenticated agent's customer. Accounts must belong to the agent's customer. Requires the CREATE_TRANSFERS permission in the agent's policy.
If the agent's policy requires approval for this amount, the transaction will be created in a pending state and must be approved by the platform via `POST /agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}/approve`.

params.name: currency
params.description: Filter by currency code

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by internal account type. Use `EMBEDDED_WALLET` to find the self-custodial wallet provisioned for the customer, or `INTERNAL_FIAT` / `INTERNAL_CRYPTO` for platform-managed holding accounts.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination (returned from previous request)

items.docs: Retrieve the internal accounts belonging to the customer this agent operates on behalf of. Use this to discover available source accounts for transfers and quotes, and to verify which accounts are accessible under the agent's `accountRestrictions` policy.

params.name: currency
params.description: Filter by currency code

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination (returned from previous request)

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of external accounts belonging to the authenticated agent's customer. Requires the MANAGE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS permission in the agent's policy.

Register a new external bank account or wallet for the authenticated agent's customer. Requires the MANAGE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS permission in the agent's policy. The `customerId` field is optional and will be inferred from the agent's associated customer if omitted.

info.name: Get agent external account by ID

params.name: externalAccountId
params.description: System-generated unique external account identifier

items.docs: Retrieve an external account belonging to the authenticated agent's customer. Returns 404 if the account exists but belongs to a different customer. Requires the MANAGE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS permission in the agent's policy.

params.name: externalAccountId
params.description: System-generated unique external account identifier

items.docs: Delete an external account belonging to the authenticated agent's customer. Requires the MANAGE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS permission in the agent's policy.
